features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty (choose one fighting style option).

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three at 11th level and four at 20th level.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail; you must use the new roll. You can use this feature once, then must finish a long rest before you can use it again. You can use it twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times starting at 17th level.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: A fighter who combines raw physical excellence with reliable, devastating strikes.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus; when making a running long jump, the distance increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: A fighter who uses tactical maneuvers and superiority dice to control the battlefield.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8). You have four dice per short or long rest; you know three maneuvers and learn more as you gain levels. A maneuver is spent when you use it and replenishes on a rest.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information compared to your own capabilities (class levels, relative stats, etc.).

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your superiority dice become d10s.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain one superiority die.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: A fighter who blends weapon mastery with abjuration and evocation magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn to cast wizard spells; spellcasting ability is Intelligence. Spell selection is mostly from abjuration and evocation, with limited spells from any school as you advance.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see before or after the additional action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
